arxiv-1905-11894.title: Jet hadronization at LHCb
arxiv-1905-11894.description: Abstract In high energy proton-proton collisions, collimated sprays of particles, called jets, result from hard scattered quarks or gluons. Jets are copiously produced in these collisions; however, the dynamic process through which quarks and gluons, collectively referred to as partons, become bound state hadrons is still not well understood.

arxiv-2101-10399.title: Anchor Distance for 3D Multi-Object Distance Estimation from 2D Single Shot
arxiv-2101-10399.creator: Hyeonwoo Yu, Jean Oh
arxiv-2101-10399.description: Abstract Visual perception of the objects in a 3D environment is a key to successful performance in autonomous driving and simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). In this paper, we present a real time approach for estimating the distances to multiple objects in a scene using only a single-shot image.

arxiv-2107-01535.title: A N-Path Receiver With Harmonic Response Suppression
arxiv-2107-01535.creator: Venkata Suresh Rayudu, Ki Yong Kim, Ranjit Gharpurey
arxiv-2107-01535.description: Abstract A downconversion receiver employing a switch-based N-path filter with reduced harmonic response around the third- and fifth- LO harmonics is presented. The N-path filter is placed in a frequency-translation feedback loop that is effective at the 3 rd 3^{\text{rd}} and the 5 th 5^{\text{\text{th}}} LO harmonics to mitigate harmonic downconversion.

arxiv-2108-05873.title: Reverse Order Law for Generalized Inverses with Indefinite Hermitian Weights
arxiv-2108-05873.creator: K. Kamaraj 1 , P. Sam Johnson 2 and Athira Satheesh K 3
arxiv-2108-05873.description: Abstract . In this paper, necessary and sufficient conditions are given for the existence of Moore-Penrose inverse of a product of two matrices in an indefinite inner product space (IIPS) in which reverse order law holds good. Rank equivalence formulas with respect to IIPS are provided and an open problem is given at the end. 1.

arxiv-2205-10257.title: Frontrunning Block Attack in PoA Clique: A Case Study Thanks: This work was in part presented at IEEE ICBC 2022.
arxiv-2205-10257.creator: Xinrui Zhang 1 , Qin Wang 3 , Rujia Li 1 2 , Qi Wang 1 ð
arxiv-2205-10257.description: Abstract As a fundamental technology of decentralized finance (DeFi), blockchain’s ability to maintain a distributed fair ledger is threatened by manipulation of block/transaction order. In this paper, we propose a frontrunning block attack against the Clique-based Proof of Authority (PoA) algorithms. Our attack can frontrun blocks from honest in-turn sealers by breaking the proper order of leader selection.

arxiv-2310-20226.title: Value sets of non-permutation polynomials over the residue class rings of integers
arxiv-2310-20226.creator: Shikui Shang
arxiv-2310-20226.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shikui Shang. In this paper, we study the value sets of non-permutation polynomial functions over the residue class ring ℤ / m ​ ℤ {\mathbb{Z}}/m{\mathbb{Z}} . When m = p r m=p^{r} is a power of some prime p p , an upper bound is given for the size of the value set of a polynomial function which is not a permutation. We also show that this upper bound can be achieved by some integral polynomials.

arxiv-2404-19194.title: Updated observational constraints on spatially-flat and non-flat Λ \Lambda CDM and XCDM cosmological models
arxiv-2404-19194.creator: Javier de Cruz Pérez {}^{\hrefhttps://orcid.org/0000-0001-8603-5447}, Chan-Gyung Park {}^{\hrefhttps://orcid.org/0000-0002-3076-2781}, Bharat Ratra {}^{\hrefhttps://orcid.org/0000-0002-7307-0726}
arxiv-2404-19194.description: Abstract We study the performance of six Λ \Lambda CDM models, with four of them allowing for non-flat spatial hypersurfaces (non-zero current value of the spatial curvature density parameter Ω k \Omega_{k} ) and three of them allowing for a non-unity value of the lensing consistency parameter A L A_{L} .

arxiv-2408-04718.title: Zero-Shot Uncertainty Quantification using Diffusion Probabilistic Models
arxiv-2408-04718.creator: Dule Shu, Amir Barati Farimani
arxiv-2408-04718.description: Abstract The success of diffusion probabilistic models in generative tasks, such as text-to-image generation, has motivated the exploration of their application to regression problems commonly encountered in scientific computing and various other domains. In this context, the use of diffusion regression models for ensemble prediction is becoming a practice with increasing popularity.

arxiv-2410-13348.title: Technical Note: Vendor-Specific Approach for Standardized Uptake Value Calculation
arxiv-2410-13348.creator: Maksym Fritsak, Hubert S. Gabryś, Preethi Mohan, Matthias Guckenberger, Stephanie Tanadini-Lang
arxiv-2410-13348.description: Abstract Background: The Standardized Uptake Value (SUV) is a critical metric in positron emission tomography (PET) imaging, used to assess metabolic activity. However, calculating SUV from DICOM files presents challenges due to vendor-specific DICOM attributes and variations in the encoding of radiotracer accumulation times.

arxiv-2412-01503.title: Phase transitions and remnants of fractionalization at finite temperature in the triangular lattice quantum loop model
arxiv-2412-01503.creator: Xiaoxue Ran, Sylvain Capponi, Junchen Rong, Fabien Alet, Zi Yang Meng
arxiv-2412-01503.description: Abstract The quantum loop and dimer models are archetypal correlated systems with local constraints. With natural foundations in statistical mechanics, they are of direct relevance to various important physical concepts and systems, such as topological order, lattice gauge theories, geometric frustrations, or more recently Rydberg arrays quantum simulators.

Existing safety measures often detect overt malicious intent but fail to address subtle, reasoning-driven vulnerabilities.

arxiv-2504-15821.title: Line Intensity Mapping Prediction from the Cosmic Dawn (CoDa) III Simulation for H α \alpha from Galaxies and the Intergalactic Medium during the Epoch of Reionization
arxiv-2504-15821.creator: Eugene Hyeonmin Lee, Joohyun Lee, Paul R. Shapiro, Pierre Ocvirk, Joseph S. W. Lewis, Taha Dawoodbhoy, Ilian T. Iliev, Luke Conaboy, Kyungjin Ahn, Hyunbae Park, Jenny G. Sorce, Dominique Aubert, Romain Teyssier, Gustavo Yepes, Yohan Dubois, Stefan Gottlöber
arxiv-2504-15821.description: Abstract The evolution of large-scale structure, galaxies and the intergalactic medium (IGM) during the Epoch of Reionization (EoR) can be probed by upcoming Line Intensity Mapping (LIM) experiments, which sample in redshift and direction without needing to resolve individual galaxies.

arxiv-2509-22673.title: PISA: An AI Pipeline for Interpretable-by-design Survival Analysis Providing Multiple Complexity–Accuracy Trade-off Models
arxiv-2509-22673.creator: Thalea Schlender a Catharina J.A. Romme b,c Yvette M. van der Linden a Luc R.C.W. van Lonkhuijzen b,c Peter A.N. Bosman d Tanja Alderliesten a

Bosman d Tanja Alderliesten a. Survival analysis is central to clinical research, informing patient prognoses, guiding treatment decisions, and optimising resource allocation. Accurate time-to-event predictions not only improve quality of life but also reveal risk factors that shape clinical practice.

arxiv-2602-24073.title: Ecological memory of hydrodynamic cues shapes growth and migration of motile microorganisms
arxiv-2602-24073.creator: Narges Kakavand, Anupam Sengupta, Email: anupam.sengupta@uni.lu
arxiv-2602-24073.description: Abstract Microorganisms live in inherently dynamic environments where repeated fluctuations in biotic and abiotic factors shape their behaviour, physiology, and overall fitness. The concept of ecological memory—the lasting imprint of prior environmental conditions—suggests that past exposures can exert prolonged effects on microbial growth, stress resilience, and phenotypic expressions.

doe-osti-3363405-a-solid-state-technolog.title: A Solid-State Technology Enabled Compact, Modular Design to Reduce DC Fast Charging Cost and Footprint
doe-osti-3363405-a-solid-state-technolog.creator: Schroedermeier, Andy
doe-osti-3363405-a-solid-state-technolog.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. The goal of this program was to develop a solid-state transformer (SST) capable of supplying 800 V DC to electric vehicle charging dispensers when connected to a 13.2 kV rms line-line, 3-phase AC grid input. The power level as tested was 1.3 MW.

pmc-10530682.title: Origins of East Caucasus Gene Pool: Contributions of Autochthonous Bronze Age Populations and Migrations from West Asia Estimated from Y-Chromosome Data
pmc-10530682.creator: Anastasia Agdzhoyan, Nasib Iskandarov, Georgy Ponomarev, Vladimir Pylev, Sergey Koshel, Vugar Salaev, Elvira Pocheshkhova, Zhaneta Kagazezheva, Elena Balanovska
pmc-10530682.description: The gene pool of the East Caucasus, encompassing modern-day Azerbaijan and Dagestan populations, was studied alongside adjacent populations using 83 Y-chromosome SNP markers. The analysis of genetic distances among 18 populations (N = 2216) representing Nakh-Dagestani, Altaic, and Indo-European language families revealed the presence of three components (Steppe, Iranian, and Dagestani) that emerged in different historical periods.

pmc-10547183.title: Identifying a developmental transition in honey bees using gene expression data
pmc-10547183.creator: Bryan C. Daniels, Ying Wang, Robert E. Page, Gro V. Amdam, Kiran R. Patil, Carl Herrmann, Kiran R. Patil, Mark Alber, Mark Alber
pmc-10547183.description: In many organisms, interactions among genes lead to multiple functional states, and changes to interactions can lead to transitions into new states. These transitions can be related to bifurcations (or critical points) in dynamical systems theory. Characterizing these collective transitions is a major challenge for systems biology.

pmc-11449284.title: PVAT-conditioned media from Dahl S rats on high fat diet promotes inflammatory cytokine secretion by activated T cells prior to the development of hypertension
pmc-11449284.creator: Yining Jin, Sheng Liu, Kimberly E. Guzmán, Ramya K. Kumar, Luca M. Kaiser, Hannah Garver, Jamie J. Bernard, Sudin Bhattacharya, Gregory D. Fink, Stephanie W. Watts, Cheryl E. Rockwell
pmc-11449284.description: There is considerable evidence that the immune system plays a role in hypertension, however this role is not fully characterized. Our previous studies demonstrated that mesenteric perivascular adipose tissue (mPVAT) harbors a large T cell population, which is a cell type identified as contributing to hypertension.

pmc-11476282.title: Establishment and Characterization of Testis Organoids with Proliferation and Differentiation of Spermatogonial Stem Cells into Spermatocytes and Spermatids
pmc-11476282.creator: Dong Zhang, Wencong Jin, Yinghong Cui, Zuping He
pmc-11476282.description: Organoids play pivotal roles in uncovering the molecular mechanisms underlying organogenesis, intercellular communication, and high-throughput drug screening. Testicular organoids are essential for exploring the genetic and epigenetic regulation of spermatogenesis in vivo and the treatment of male infertility. However, the formation of testicular organoids with full spermatogenesis has not yet been achieved.

pmc-12443937.title: Production of human papillomavirus type 16 virus-like particles in Physcomitrella photobioreactors
pmc-12443937.creator: Paul Alexander Niederau, Maria Caroline Weilguny, Sarah Chamas, Caitlin Elizabeth Turney, Juliana Parsons, Marta Rodríguez-Franco, Sebastian N W Hoernstein, Eva L Decker, Henrik Toft Simonsen, Ralf Reski
pmc-12443937.description: Key message First production of virus-like particles as a vaccine candidate in a non-vascular plant. AbstractVirus-like particles (VLPs) are self-assembling nanoparticles composed of viral structural proteins which mimic native virions but lack viral DNA and infectivity. VLPs are a resourceful class of biopharmaceuticals applied as subunit vaccines or as delivery vehicles for drugs and nucleic acids.

pmc-12567600.title: Global Transmission, Prevention, Control, and Treatment of Mpox Virus in 2025: A Comprehensive Review from Infection Mechanisms to Vaccine Development
pmc-12567600.creator: Quan Quan, Nan Wu, Ying-Hua Luo, Yan-Jun Tang, Yan-Zhi Liu, Xi-Chun Huang, Jun-Hao Li, Wan-Xia Ren, Cheng-Hao Jin
pmc-12567600.description: The World Health Organization (WHO) declared the mpox (MPX) outbreak a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) on 23 July 2022, and 14 August 2024, respectively, underscoring the confirmed and concerning global spread of the disease. A gap exists in our fundamental understanding of the mpox virus (MPXV), despite its genetic relatedness to the variola virus (VARV).

pmc-12590790.title: Insights into the multifunctionality of viral glycoproteins F and HN in the lifecycle and pathogenesis of Newcastle disease virus: a systematic review
pmc-12590790.creator: Si Ma, Rongjing Xia, Wenjie Wu, Zhiqiang Duan
pmc-12590790.description: Newcastle disease virus (NDV) is a representative paramyxovirus that usually causes severe infections and substantial economic losses to the global poultry industry. Over the years, NDV has attracted widespread attention as a promising oncolytic virotherapy agent and vector vaccine against many pathogens and an important prototype for elucidating the replication and pathogenesis of other paramyxoviruses.

pmc-12692780.title: Preparation of Electrode Coke and Determination of Its Physico-Chemical Properties
pmc-12692780.creator: Aigul T Ordabaeva, Zainulla M Muldakhmetov, Mazhit G Meiramov, Sergey V Kim, Erbolat E Kuanyshbekov, Shuga B Kasenova
pmc-12692780.description: The physico-chemical and electrophysical properties of carbon coke obtained by coking composite mixtures of pitches isolated from coal tar coking plants of JSC “Shubarkol Komir” and “Qarmet” are investigated. The component composition of the initial resins and the obtained pitches was determined by gas–liquid chromatography methods.

pmc-12743792.title: Gender Disparities in Medicare Reimbursement for Foot and Ankle Surgery: 10-Year Insights Across Specialties
pmc-12743792.creator: Rachit Saggar, Abdulganeey Olawin, Joseph Mullen, Warren Austin, Eva Heidinger, Sam Ewalefo, Chukwudi Onyeukwu, Jarrett Cain, Lauren Lewis, Peter Mangone, MaCalus Hogan
pmc-12743792.description: Research Type:Level 3 - Retrospective cohort study, Case-control study, Meta-analysis of Level 3 studiesIntroduction/Purpose:Gender disparities persist in the surgical workforce, with orthopedics projected to reach gender parity only by 2236. The foot and ankle subspecialty presents a unique opportunity to examine disparities across both orthopedics and podiatry.

pmc-12827548.title: Integrated metabolomic and transcriptomic analysis reveals the effects and mechanisms of Jingfang Baidu powder on acute lung injury
pmc-12827548.creator: Zimo Zhu, Baimei Cui, Rong Dai, Guoxian Hu, Sue Xu, Xianfang Zhao, Wenjing Wang, Xiufang Li
pmc-12827548.description: BackgroundAcute lung injury (ALI) is one of the most prevalent respiratory diseases globally. Jingfang Baidu Powder (JF) is a clinically approved traditional Chinese medicine used for treating respiratory infectious diseases. However, its effects and mechanism in the context of ALI remain poorly understood.

pmc-13005116.title: Symptom Network Dynamics during Antipsychotic Treatment in First-Episode Psychosis
pmc-13005116.creator: Melissa G Zandstra, Floortje E Scheepers, Gabriela Lunansky, Silvana Galderisi, Birte Y Glenthøj, Inge Winter-van Rossum, Metten Somers, Edwin van Dellen
pmc-13005116.description: Background and Hypothesis: Treatment response in first-episode psychosis varies substantially, yet underlying factors remain poorly understood. Symptom network theory suggests that inter-symptom relationships may influence treatment response. We hypothesized that symptom networks at baseline, as well as dynamic interactions over time, would differ between remitters and non-remitters, and that specific antipsychotics would show differential symptom-targeting effects.

pmc-13056602.title: Weighted vest interventions in older adults: a mini-review of implementation, benefits, and limitations
pmc-13056602.creator: Hongcheng Luo, Xing Zhang, Hansen Li, Mingyue Yin, Zhaoqian Li
pmc-13056602.description: Weighted vests (WVs) enable adjustable external loading during daily activities and exercise. Although experimental studies in older adults exist, their findings have not been comprehensively integrated. This narrative review summarizes implementation, main findings, and limitations. In October 2025, we searched Web of Science, PubMed, and EBSCOhost and conducted backward and forward citation searching.
